guitar.modelsText: Fender Mustang / Fender Jaguar / Martin D-18E
guitar.notes: Confirmed — Kurt Cobain's Mustang, Jaguar, and the Martin D-18E from MTV Unplugged are all extremely well documented.

tone.summary: A tight signal chain using a light overdrive (Green OD) into a classic Fender/Hiwatt style amp (US Deluxe), paired with a small cab (US 2x12). Minimal reverb provides the required 'dry room' feel, keeping the tone clean and punchy.
